MemeDef.label: sword way
MemeDef.description: The sword is neither good nor bad; the hand is. The true sword is the intent (Jian Yi): the steel only carries it. Mastery is won by cutting, and by tempering the body until it becomes a blade.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[deity0_name] split a mountain with a single stroke and never drew the blade.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[deity0_name] showed the first [memberName] that the cut is made before the hand moves.
intro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The early [memberNamePlural] of the [place_summary] [place_name] built a sword mound where every master's blade rests.
conflict(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->A powerful [foeLeader] broke a thousand swords and believed the sect broken with them.
founderJoin(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[founderName] came down from the mountain with nothing but intent, and [memberName] followed.
victory(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[founderName] faced the [foeLeader] unarmed, and the [foeSoldiers] fled before a blade they could not see.
setup(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The believers were scattered by the Iron Calamity, so they gathered around what no machine could break.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The believers spread out and grew in number, each tempering their own blade.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->Disciple, the old masters used to say:
lesson(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->steel can break, but true intent endures.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->You will understand it after ten thousand cuts.
archistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The archotechs measure everything, except the moment before a cut.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[inTheEnd], the machines will fall silent, and only intent will remain.
animistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->Every blade that rests in the sword mound keeps a little of its master's spirit.

IdeoPresetDef.label: formless sword sect
IdeoPresetDef.description: Disciples of the Formless Sword: the blade is only a tool, the intent is the sword. Cultivation is venerated, duels are encouraged, the elders lead and the demonic arts are forbidden. Your colony stays independent; the sect is a teaching, not a master.

PreceptDef.label: sword master
PreceptDef.description: The master who keeps the discipline of the blade and tempers the bodies of the disciples. Only one whose body has become a sword may hold the office: the Formless Sword says you cannot teach a temper you have never felt.

RitualPatternDef.ritualExplanation: The sword master tempers one disciple's Sword Body by a single grade: iron, cold steel, star-iron, celestial jade. A failed tempering costs only the materials.

PreceptDef.label: tempering of the sword body
PreceptDef.description: The disciple kneels before the sword mound while the sword master recites the ten thousand cuts of Qing Feng. Spirit stones burn around them like a forge without fire; what is tempered is not the steel but the body that will carry the intent.
